instruction: Open Materials Studio and create a new polyethylene chain with 5 repeating units (chain length 5). Build a crystal structure using default parameters. Export the crystal structure as a CIF file to the desktop. Then open the exported CIF file in VESTA, rotate the crystal to the standard crystallographic orientation, and adjust the fractional coordinate display range so that x(max), y(max), and z(max) are all set to 0.1. Save the resulting VESTA file to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\polyethylene_crystal.vesta'.
